data.name: Ghandhara Automobiles Limited
data.description: Ghandhara Automobiles Limited (Formerly Ghandhara Nissan Limited) was incorporated on August 8, 1981 in Pakistan as a private limited company and subsequently converted into a public limited company on May 24, 1992. The Company is a subsidiary of Bibojee Services (Private) Limited (BSL). The principal business of the Company is assembly / progressive manufacturing of vehicles including JAC Trucks, import and sale of parts / Nissan, Dongfeng and Renault vehicles in completely built-up condition and assembly of other vehicles under contract agreement.
